learning.title: Describe Railway infrastructure with the IaC program, not railway.json
learning.trigger: A task asks for per-service railway.json or railway.toml config as code for a new Railway service.
learning.rule: Railway documents config as code (railway.json) as deprecated: new services cannot opt in and the files stop being read on 2026-12-01. Use the IaC program .railway/railway.ts, evaluated by railway config plan and apply (CLI 5.42.1 or newer), with the pinned railway SDK. Dockerfile paths, health checks, pre-deploy commands, restart policy and replicas are fields of that program.

Secrets use preserve() so plan output never shows them. Run railway config plan --detailed-exit-code after every manual change (secrets, domain, proxy deletion); a non-zero exit is drift to fix in the program. Never use config apply --confirm-destructive.

verification.requirement: Record the CLI version, the plan output with no secret values, and the exit code.

learning.boundary: Deprecation dates come from the Railway docs read on 2026-10-21. Re-read them before relying on the date. Do not add watchPatterns when no service has a GitHub source; they gate nothing.
